points: Your site shows 1375 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, which gives cold traffic no reason to act. Put 1375 on the creative and in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 20% off at home thyroid kits, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it. A first time buyer gets no reason to act. Put the 20% off in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

Your 29 copy ads use 21 different openings, and the biggest opens only 5 ads. Each story gets too little repetition to build recognition. Pick the two best openings and build the next batch from them, three variations each.

Seven ads have run 60 days or more, and the oldest opened 18 May 2026. Without variations, that winner is the only message readers see. Build three more versions of the symptoms opener with a different offer line and review quote.
